reference: She usually sings, but yesterday she whistled all afternoon.
sk: Zvyčajne spieva, ale včera celé popoludnie pískala
cz: Obvykle zpívá, ale včera celé odpoledne pískala
acceptable: {She usually sings|Usually she sings|She normally sings|Normally she sings}, but yesterday she whistled {all afternoon|the whole afternoon|all afternoon long}.
{She usually sings|Usually she sings|She normally sings|Normally she sings}, but she whistled {all afternoon|the whole afternoon} yesterday.

mistakes.text: {She usually sings|Usually she sings}, but yesterday she whistles all afternoon.
{She usually sings|Usually she sings}, but yesterday she was whistling all afternoon.
She usually sang, but yesterday she whistled all afternoon.

mistakes.feedback_cz: Zpívá obvykle i dnes, patří sem Present Simple: „sings“.

mistakes.feedback_sk: Pre zvyk patrí Present Simple: „usually sings“.

mistakes.feedback_sk: Pred „whole afternoon“ chýba „the“, alebo povedz „all afternoon“.
